Indian Media Marks Friendship Day with Wishes and Gift Ideas

Indian media outlets are marking Friendship Day, celebrated on August 2, by sharing various ways to express appreciation for friends. Coverage includes collections of shayari (poetry), messages, and quotes to send to friends. Several outlets also provided gift ideas under ₹500 and suggested places to visit in Delhi for a memorable celebration. The content focuses on celebrating the bond of friendship through messages, activities, and thoughtful gestures.
